All-time record Q3 2020 — record revenue, gross profit, gross margin, operating income, net income, EPS and operating cash flow.
Revenue +80.4% to $36.8M; North America +60.4%, e-commerce +100%+ (Amazon +111% to $5.6M, ~22% of domestic revenue), Europe/Nordic +182%.
Net income $4.8M ($0.06/diluted share); adjusted EBITDA $6.9M (swing from a prior-year loss).
DSD network expanded to 147 partners covering ~75% of major metro markets; ~30% of doors DSD-serviced with a ~70% multi-year target; stores DSD-serviced more than doubled vs. Q2.
Industry-wide US aluminum can shortage (~30 billion cans short for 2021) — the prominent headwind; Celsius sourcing supplemental cans from Europe and Asia, expecting cost of goods to rise.
Management guided gross margin to a low-40s run rate for 2021 (down from 46.7% in Q3), normalizing toward 2020 levels as new US can plants ramp into 2022.
Company became debt-free post-quarter, paying off ~$10M of Func acquisition bonds; ended Q3 with $52.2M cash.
Door count exceeded 79,000 (+32% YoY); convenience ACV up to ~16% on Speedway 2,700-store expansion plus Xtra Mart, Kum & Go, Union Pacific additions.
On-The-Go Sticks expanded into 2,700 Walmart and 1,200+ Publix locations; exclusive Kiwi-Guava-Lime launch at Walmart.
Health club/specialty channel down ~23%; expected to remain materially down in Q4 with recovery through 2021.
October North America orders running over 50% above prior year; management does not provide formal guidance ('we are just getting started').
FAST protein snack portfolio to be tested and seeded in North America in Q1 2021; robust 2021 innovation pipeline planned.

Asked which regions are best covered, where gaps remain, and next-phase DSD optimization timeline; plus the Target DSD conversion, DSD lift magnitude, Walmart flip timing, and Speedway/C-store growth.

At ~147 DSD partners covering ~75% of major metro markets, gaps in Mid-Atlantic, Northern California, parts of Texas and the middle of the country. Target conversion (1,200 stores) involved extensive back-office work through Sep/Oct, with more in 2021. Walmart (~50% DSD-serviced) flips the remainder in Q1/early 2021. Convenience ACV ~16%, with more accounts expected in the March-April 2021 window; Speedway feedback positive.
On-The-Go Sticks, new flavors, vitamin channel & can shortage

Asked whether On-The-Go Sticks (now 6 SKUs) is a material part of North America business; timing of new flavors; the vitamin channel and GNC disruption; and whether the can-shortage limiting factor is facility capacity or can-manufacturer raw materials.

On-The-Go Sticks expands usage occasions, expected meaningful but not primary — RTDs remain the main focus. New flavors (strawberry marshmallow, blueberry frost) are in the Nordics, not yet slotted for the US. Vitamin/supplement channel challenged (down ~23%) but expected to recover. The limiting factor is the physical can body — NA short ~30 billion cans in 2021, not filling capacity; Celsius sourcing from Asia and Europe.
M&A outlook & North America growth composition
Asked whether the strong cash position changes the M&A/brand-extension outlook; and for a bucketed breakdown of Q3 North America growth into same-store vs. SKU vs. door.

Ample opportunity but strategy is focused execution and profitable growth; ended Q3 with $52M cash (~$42M after $10M debt payoff), debt-free and cash-flow positive, funds earmarked for inventory and positive-ROI cooler placements in 2021. M&A only if accretive. Initially declined the growth breakdown ('no guidance'), then offered ~30% same-store growth with the remainder from new distribution.
Can shortage timing/margin, Amazon margin, DSD completeness & 2021 products

Asked whether the can shortage impacts margins immediately or in 2021 and if supply is adequate; the Amazon/e-commerce margin profile and revenue share; whether more DSD partners are needed beyond ~75% coverage; and whether new product lines are planned for 2021.

Can sourcing begins Q4 2020 with POs already in place ensuring adequate supply for 2021 demand. E-commerce ~22% of North America revenue in Q3; account-level margins not disclosed; reiterated low-40s 2021 margin run rate. DSD partners are independent wholesalers within the Anheuser-Busch, Pepsi and KDP networks; at ~75% metro coverage Celsius is strong but seeking gap-region partners. Robust 2021 innovation pipeline plus FAST protein snack portfolio tested/seeded in North America in Q1 2021.
